label: Every fact true at a world has an admitted reason there
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the unrestricted fact PSR at w in the #755 arena. Every fact that holds at w has some fact admitted at w as a reason for it (EXPLAINED_ABSENCE_1, the admitted-explicability property). An admitted reason need not be true, necessitating, independent of its target or a genuine explanation; those are separate quality conditions. It is not restricted to contingent facts. With excluded middle it holds wherever the contingent-fact PSR holds once every true necessary fact is admitted as a reason for every true necessary fact (necessaryReasons, InquiryScopeMap clause 3), so its reach beyond contingent facts constrains nothing about which reason a necessary fact has.
